why_lead: The peak-rates rally became the dominant crowd narrative on newly published evidence: October payrolls below expectations (n2064, n2063, n2065), 'Wall Street says the Fed is done' (n2066) and the best week of 2023 (n0134). why_smaller: Tesla: founder-cult dip-buying on Musk's $4 trillion comment (n0776), buy-the-dip and split coverage (n0480, n0996) with the stock -15.57% over 20 sessions; fundamentals headlines (n1920, n1308, n0742, n0645) supply the break.
DraftKings: +16.46% on a jump in users and revenue (n0922) with betting-culture coverage (n0363, n2108): a consumer-gambling growth narrative.
Bitcoin: newly published verdict (n1079) and ETF-calendar evidence (n1074, n1080) shift the story from courtroom to approval queue, while bitcoin's flat week against ARKK supplies the break.
